hints.title: Path Frequency Accumulation
hints.text: For each trip, trace the unique simple path between start and destination and count how many times each vertex is visited.

hints.title: Weighted Cost Calculation
hints.text: Each vertex contributes its visit count multiplied by its price to the total trip cost.

hints.title: Independent Set Tree Reduction
hints.text: Since no two adjacent vertices can be halved, solve with tree subproblems: halving a node forces all its children to keep full cost.

hints.title: Tree Dynamic Optimization Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Paths computed per trip followed by a single tree subproblem pass.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for tree recursion and node visit counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Aggregates trip frequency first, then recognizes independent set tree optimization.
